Resolves #21796

Use the existing Engine E2E reach map for stylesheet changes with a proven standalone example owner and an executed browser spec. Preserve the full fallback for shared styles, unknown ownership and stylesheet moves or removals.

Evidence: L2 (workflow and selector tests, plus replay on five exact historical CI merge trees) → L2 required for the classifier and its controls. Rollout measurements follow the merge.

Related: #21541, #21540. Approved scope in [Discussion #21725](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/21725).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | An eligible mirrored CSS class selects Engine-tier specs reaching its own app plus the existing unnamed controls. A local-only or Brain-gated owner keeps the full tier. |
| AC-2 | Controls cover a foreign theme reference, a foreign import through a helper, a stylesheet import, missing metadata, a mixed CSS and Engine diff, removals and renames across the E2E admission boundary. |
| AC-3 | Five historical replays select 11 shard jobs where hosted CI started 75. They retain the specs containing all five observed failures. Existing required contexts and exact-head checks are preserved. Admitted `dev` pushes still select the full tier. |
| AC-4 | Post-merge timing and regression-detection measurements are listed below. |

## Deltas from ticket

The PR workflow supplies a separate list of added or modified stylesheet candidates. It retains the prior CSS path when a rename leaves the E2E admission boundary. Existing path-only selector callers continue to receive the conservative fallback.

## Test Evidence

- 118 focused Playwright unit tests across E2E reach, E2E selection and the workflow classifier passed at the committed head.
- The historical replays used each run's original changed files, immutable synthetic merge tree, Engine allowlist and durations. All 15 stylesheet changes in those five replays had added status.

| Historical run | Actual → selected E2E shards |
| --- | ---: |
| [Scheduler Event Editor](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44862268192/job/136718071428) | 15 → 7 |
| [Scheduler Zoom](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44858788399/job/136718863819) | 15 → 1 |
| [Scheduler Live Updates](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44856309710/job/136703708407) | 15 → 1 |
| [Gantt Task Columns](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44862877504/job/136719968622) | 15 → 1 |
| [Board Big Data](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44870694769/job/136748140061) | 15 → 1 |

For each tree, missing metadata and each shared control (`Global.css`, Board `Card.css`, and the examples ConfigurationViewport) restored the full tier. Current-tree checks also covered the shared Dashboard Palette and Helix’s outside class consumer. These are selector and job-count replays.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] On three comparable example PRs, record push-to-required-green and per-job queue wait alongside the #21541 baseline.
- [ ] For an attributable `dev` regression, record merge-to-first-red before and after when comparable evidence exists.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21796 (ACs and ledger), D#21725's graduated body and Julia's Step-Back point 3 (owner inside `dirname(entry)`, no outside `additionalThemeFiles` consumer, at least one executed spec reaching the entry), `dev`'s `buildScripts/util/e2eSpecReach.mjs` (`APP_REFERENCE`, `entryOf`, `unnamed`) and `e2eCiSelection.mjs` (`FOUNDATION`, `selectSpecs`), and `classify-test-scope.yml`'s selection step.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** A stylesheet narrows only when its owner is proven: it mirrors a mounted class in one example, nothing outside that example names it, and an executed spec reaches it. The selection runs that example's specs plus the specs the map cannot place. Shared, global, moved or ambiguous CSS stays on the full tier. It must not hardcode an example list, and its tests must prove each fallback with a control.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches, after `fe8f73d0e9`. At `973b10c30d` I ran `selectSpecs` on owned stylesheets: `grid/contentSizedRows` selected 7 specs without `StandaloneExamplesThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs`, and `scheduler/liveUpdates` selected 6 without `Gridlines.spec.mjs`. Both specs visit those examples through a bare `/examples/${…}` loop that the reach map never saw, while their literal paths placed them. At this head `UNBOUNDED_EXAMPLE_REFERENCE` keeps any spec whose closure carries such a route in `unnamed`. The same three probes now select both specs at 9–10 specs each, still far from the full tier.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with friction→gold: a measured CI-capacity friction (#21541's receipts, Sophie's 84.6% queue share) became a graduated, falsifiable selector change, not an ad-hoc skip list.
